sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id 
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE type = 'VYBER KARTOU'
    AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
    GROUP BY account_id
) AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.amount < T2.avg_amount
AND strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '1998'
AND T1.type = 'VYBER KARTOU'
